name: Isselburg (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:3:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Isselburg (a white castle above a wall on red).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident Münster of 20 July 1976 the city of Isselburg was granted the right to bear arms, a flag, a banner and an official seal; the flag is red, white and red striped 1:3:1.

features.role: Isselburg arms — castle above wall on red
